title: Presocratic cave rituals

tellings.quote: there were caving rituals. There are prescratic caving rituals. A guy named Peter Kingsley writes about this
Peter Kingsley writes about prescratic rituals even before the Elusinian mystery rituals
tellings.difference: Calls the rituals sensory deprivation, says they came before Eleusis and adds Heidegger as a credit.
tellings.link_reason: Same presocratic ritual practice described by Peter Kingsley, which the story calls caving rituals.

plain: The Greek thinkers before Socrates are said to have practiced rituals in caves, which Michels describes as sensory deprivation and as older than the Eleusinian mysteries, the famous secret Greek initiation rites. Michels tells this as something he has read in the writer Peter Kingsley, and in one episode also credits the German philosopher Martin Heidegger. It is told to suggest that early Western philosophy grew out of altered states of mind.
